identity.headline: Software & AI Engineer — builds production AI that actually ships

experience.title: AI Engineer
bullets: Architected the core AI matching engine for positions and shift allocation, reducing unfilled urgent requests by 40%.
Migrated search and allocation workflows to a distributed, asynchronous architecture, cutting concurrent processing latency by 50% during peak demand hours.
Automated the credential verification and DBS check pipelines via LLM-driven document extraction and external API clients, accelerating candidate onboarding time from 2 weeks to under 15 minutes.

experience.title: AI Software Developer
bullets: Engineered scalable, multi-tenant services serving 20+ clients and over 1M users across 10+ interconnected microservices.
Developed Vericlient, a Python interface facilitating client integration with Veridas APIs.
Led a performance optimization program: p90 response time from 40s to 5s under high load, 10x throughput increase without additional infrastructure.
Shipped 80+ features and REST endpoints across core backend libraries.
Boosted AI inference performance by 60% on average by integrating optimized model formats and serving frameworks.
Created synthetic data generation tools and RAG-ready data pipelines.

involvement.title: Technical Trainer
bullets: Delivered foundational software development training to 100+ career switchers as part of a regional reskilling program led by the Government of Navarra and Veridas.
Co-designed and taught programming fundamentals and core JavaScript modules to ~20 participants per cohort.

projects.name: Vericlient
